headline: Alphabet raises $4.19 billion in Canadian dollar bond offering
summary: Google parent Alphabet raised US$4.19 billion through a Canadian bond offering, with proceeds earmarked for general corporate purposes, including potential repayment of outstanding debt.
why: Mega-cap US technology firms frequently tap foreign debt markets to diversify investor bases and optimize funding costs for capital expenditure and debt refinancing.

impacts.name: Alphabet
impacts.why: Completed issuance enhances debt liquidity and supports corporate financing needs.
